search_parameters.q: Is GST charged on individual health insurance premiums in India?

text_blocks.snippet: No, GST is not charged on individual health insurance premiums in India.

list.snippet: Individual Policies: Effective from September 22, 2025, the Goods and Services Tax (GST) rate on all individual health insurance policies (including family floater and senior citizen plans) was reduced from 18% to zero percent, making them fully exempt from GST.
Group/Corporate Policies: Keep in mind that employer-provided, group, or corporate health insurance policies still attract an 18% GST rate.

text_blocks.snippet: For further details, you can consult the official announcement on the Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance or read the comprehensive breakdown on Tata Capital.

reconstructed_markdown:
No, GST is not charged on individual health insurance premiums in India. [0]

- Individual Policies: Effective from September 22, 2025, the Goods and Services Tax \(GST\) rate on all individual health insurance policies \(including family floater and senior citizen plans\) was reduced from 18% to zero percent, making them fully exempt from GST. [0] [1] [2]
- Group/Corporate Policies: Keep in mind that employer\-provided, group, or corporate health insurance policies still attract an 18% GST rate. [0]

For further details, you can consult the official announcement on the [Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance](https://financialservices.gov.in/exemption-gst-all-individual-life-insurance-and-health-insurance-policies) or read the comprehensive breakdown on [Tata Capital](https://www.tatacapital.com/blog/insurance/gst-on-health-insurance-premium/). [0] [1]
